protocol.selection: three fixed examples chosen before this backtest
protocol.scorer: cumulative frequency with canonical rank; prior dates only
protocol.period: recent 30% of eligible draws, split between dates
protocol.same_day: all target-date draws excluded from scoring
protocol.wheel_comparison: legacy versus certified; identical pool and cost
protocol.interpretation: Uniform-draw probability dominance does not require more hits on each finite historical sample. Counts can decrease. No historical result is used to accept or reject the new wheel.
protocol.prizes: not modeled; Joker second urn is not included
